title: Chow mein/lo mein
intro: Chow mein is a Cantonese stir-fried noodle dish built around pan-fried egg noodles, traditionally cooked until crisp at the base and topped with a glossy stir-fry of meat and vegetables. Its appeal comes from the contrast between the crunchy noodle cake underneath and the tender, well-sauced topping spooned over it.
